notes.title: ✨ A Special Surprise for Our Players! ✨
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45666811/a538362ec0b10a67f97d82a82ff3dcce016058e4.jpg"][/img]
Hi guys, xD

We’ve just launched [i]The Chronicles of Lancelot: Combo Edition[/i] at $34.99…
But we’ve heard your voices and want to celebrate with the community 💖[/p][p]👉 Starting today, the Combo Edition is available at a [b]new special price: $29.99[/b]![/p][p]This is the best time to experience both Part 1 & Part 2 together in one legendary journey. ⚔️
Thank you for supporting indie developers and LGBTQ+ storytelling in games – your love keeps us going![/p][p]Grab your copy now and join Arthur & Lancelot on their full adventure:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3773010/The_Chronicles_of_Lancelot_COMBO/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
